instruction: Fix `parse_kv` so a value containing '=' is preserved (split on the first '=' only, not every one).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/fileops.py b/fileops.py
--- a/fileops.py
+++ b/fileops.py
@@ -33,7 +33,7 @@
             line = line.strip()
             if not line:
                 continue
-            key, value = line.split("=")
+            key, value = line.split("=", 1)
             result[key] = value
     return result
